{{Top|leg}}
'''Echo One''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].
Echo One was in charge to give the squadron status report to the [[Flight leader/Legends|Flight leader]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

[[Evenyl Yob]] served as Echo One prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Even with great maneuvering for a rookie pilot, her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] had been disabled and shot down by [[Dren Melne]] during the [[Battle at TFP-9]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
